name: Non-Power-of-2 Texture Swizzling
aliases: Swizzled Texture Addressing with Bitwise Carry Propagation (for non-power-of-2)
definition: A variant of swizzled addressing for textures with dimensions not powers of two, where the texture is padded to tile boundaries. The lower bits follow the swizzle pattern, while higher bits encode the tile index in row-major order.
summary: Non-Power-of-2 Texture Swizzling computes memory offsets for non-power-of-two textures by padding to tile boundaries and using explicit carry propagation logic for row transitions, unlike standard power-of-2 swizzling.
